## CHARACTER SHEET

A blank character sheet for recording your Maze Rats character's abilities, attack bonus, HP, and inventory. Print this sheet or use the [interactive character generator](https://engine.moddable.games/play/?game=maze-rats&variant=character-sheet) to create a new character with randomised appearance, personality, and starting gear.
